name: Draft Low 2
description: A low-drop trainer for runners who want a natural, close-to-the-ground ride. The 4mm drop and 21mm stack encourage a midfoot landing and give excellent ground-feel on faster efforts.

semantic_links.intent: Grip and versatility for mixed surfaces
semantic_links.evidenced_by: Best neutral trainers for wide feet that grip well on both pavement and occasional towpath runs?
I don’t want a shoe with a lot of gimmicks or tech—just a simple, reliable neutral trainer for wide feet. Any recommendations?
